pages.title: The Daily Grind
pages.text: Connect the workshop to the kitchen; chocolate is a useful workday snack.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Feed wheat into a powered Millstone. Collect the actual milled flour; no large harvest is required.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Power a Millstone from its side with a cogwheel and insert an ingredient at the top. Collect the ground result manually or through extraction automation.
